quality_highlights.aspect: Comprehensive reference with three clearly delineated feature categories, working YAML examples for every major use case, :::note admonition for safe-output limitation, and a full Related Documentation footer.
formatMissingPermissionsMessage provides two distinct resolution paths (add permissions vs reduce toolsets) with concrete YAML examples and a docs URL - textbook enterprise error design.

single_file_improvements.issue: ValidateIncludedPermissions error message (line 338) opens with redundant 'ERROR:' prefix and follows with vague 'The permission set must be explicitly declared' - misleading because 'permission set' implies ALL permissions, not just the missing ones.

run-started message 'is exhuming regressions for this {event_type}...' uses thematic language that misrepresents the activity (exhume = dig up corpse; the workflow investigates future regression risk, not existing regressions). Confusing to PR reviewers unfamiliar with the zombie theme.
